| colspan="100%" align="left" style="width:50px;"|  '''Notes:'''{{refbegin}} {{note|necklace|1}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.<br />{{note|necklace2|2}} A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played; however, no votes were cast against its user.<br />{{note|tie|3}} The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote would commence.<br />{{note|ambassadors|4}} At the ambassadors meeting, the four ambassadors agreed to vote Maxime out of the game.<br />{{note|deadlock|5}} A deadlock tie occurred, thus forcing the tied castaways to draw rocks.<br />{{note|medical|6}} This contestant was evacuated from the jury for medical reasons.<br />{{note|maxime|7}} Maxime was later brought back into the game, and thus was removed from the jury.<br />{{note|jessica|8}} Jessica came in last in the Immunity Challenge and was directly eliminated from the game.<br />{{note|tieddestinies|9}}  Pierre-Marie was Naïs's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was also eliminated when Naïs was voted out.<br />{{note|final8|10}}  At the final 8, Claire, Jérôme M. and Maxime competed in an elimination challenge. Maxime came in last and was eliminated.<br />{{note|final5|11}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Jérôme S. and Claire came in last and were eliminated.<br />
{{refend}}
